The train captures effective Burst coordinate and native packet metadata, samples live owner ATK/buffs and target mitigation at each delivery, and preserves native FixedCritRate 0.5 under its explicit probability hypothesis. Recasts replace earlier trains; living off-field owners continue; defeated owners cancel; defeated targets receive no later hit.

The domain endpoint tick is inclusive while domain bonuses remain half-open, so an endpoint tick does not receive those bonuses. Before and after each domain expansion/DoT hit, exact u128 comparison rejects a living target below 10% HP as an unsupported execute branch; target kind is unavailable, so the general 10% description threshold is used conservatively. Fatal incoming damage to Baicang during an active domain rejects as unsupported immunity. These rules do not establish Silence/Objurgate/Bless, the boss-specific 5% execute branch, or a complete kit.
